components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White bordered action for everything that is not the main step.

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Label-above field with Control Edge border and focus outline.
components.css: .ds-label { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink, #172033); font-weight: 650; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #aab7c5; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--ink, #172033); background: var(--surface, #fff); font: inherit; font-weight: 400; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #7a8796; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #2f6f9f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Top Navigation Tabs
components.description: Compact tab row with a 3px navy underline on the active tab.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d6dde6); background: #fff; } .ds-nav-tab { min-height: 40px; padding: 9px 12px; border: 0; border-bottom: 3px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #5f6b7a); font: inherit; font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-tab:hover { color: var(--ink, #172033); background: var(--surface-soft, #eef2f6); } .ds-nav-tab.ds-active { color: var(--navy, #173a5e); border-bottom-color: var(--navy, #173a5e); } .ds-nav-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #2f6f9f); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The interface should read like a reconciled ledger page at a central-bank desk. It is quiet, ruled, and exact. Every screen is a set of bordered white sheets on a pale cool canvas. Navy carries authority, and figures sit in tabular columns so balances line up. Nothing decorates: no shadows, no gradients, no motion. Structure comes from 1px rules, tonal fills, and heavy uppercase labels.

One visual system serves two densities. The institutional shell (Bank Indonesia, Participants, Auditor) is compact: 16px card padding, 0.84rem table text, 9–10px cells. The retail shell (Retail Customer, Merchant) uses the same tokens with more room: 24px card padding and 46px buttons. The guided-demo rail is the only surface that inverts to navy.

Confirmed anti-reference: the crypto/Web3 dashboard. That means no neon, no glowing coins, no dark trading-terminal mood, and no gradient hero panels. This is a monetary authority's utility tool, not a token exchange.
keyCharacteristics: Flat white sheets on a cool grey canvas, separated by 1px cool-grey rules.
One navy voice for authority: primary actions, active navigation, and key figures.
Tabular numerals on every monetary value.
Heavy, tracked, uppercase micro-labels above data.
System sans only; no web fonts.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Reserve Navy is the only filled accent. A screen should have one navy filled button per task area. Everything else is a white secondary button.

rules.name: The Status Is Text Rule
rules.body: Status (active, pending, frozen) is conveyed by colored text or a tinted banner, never by a saturated fill block.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every monetary value, balance, and count uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Numeric table cells are right-aligned.

rules.name: The Label-Above Rule
rules.body: Data is introduced by a tracked uppercase label in Slate or Ledger Blue, never by a colon-suffixed inline label.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Never add a shadow. If an element needs separation, give it a border or a different tonal layer.

dos: Do use var(--navy), var(--line), and the other :root custom properties in frontend/src/styles.css. They are the live source of these tokens.
Do keep one Reserve Navy filled button per task area. Every other action is a white secondary button.
Do set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on every Rupiah amount and right-align numeric columns.
Do introduce data with a 0.72rem, 800-weight, 0.08em-tracked uppercase label.
Do separate surfaces with 1px Rule Line borders and tonal fills.
Do keep the 3px Focus Blue outline with a 2px offset on every interactive element.
Do keep institutional screens dense (16px padding, 0.84rem tables) and retail screens roomier (24px padding, 46px buttons).
donts: Don't add box-shadow, gradients, glows, or blur.
Don't drift toward a crypto/Web3 dashboard: no neon accents, glowing coin imagery, dark trading-terminal themes, or gradient heroes.
Don't hardcode hex values in components.
Don't use saturated fills for status. Status is colored text or a tinted banner.
Don't add web fonts. The system sans and system mono stacks are the typography.
Don't use dark surfaces outside the demo rail header.
